pages.title: Fluids, Pipes and Pumps
pages.text: Create fluids flow through **Fluid Pipes** driven by a **Mechanical Pump**. Without a pump, pipes only connect; they do not move liquid.

pages.title: Mechanical Pump
pages.text: Its arrow shows flow direction, not the rotation. [#](2E5AAC)[Wrench](entry://create_basics/tools_wrench)[#]() it to flip. It pulls from the pipe behind it and pushes into the pipe in front, up to 16 blocks.

pages.title: Fluid Tank
pages.text: Stores fluid. Tanks can be joined up to 3 wide and many layers tall. In survival you cannot fill them by hand, use pipes, spouts or drains.

pages.title: Spout
pages.text: Fills items beneath it, such as buckets or potions, from a fluid supply. Items sit on a [#](2E5AAC)[depot or belt](entry://create_basics/item_logistics)[#]() under it.

pages.title: Item Drain
pages.text: Empties fluid out of items like buckets and bottles into pipes. Right-click to pour from your hand.

**Big supplies**: a pipe end in a pool pulls source blocks, and a vanilla water pool with two sources refills itself.\
\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Tip:** a **Hose Pulley** lowered into a large enough body, such as an ocean, gives or drains without running out.

pages.title: Hose Pulley
pages.text: Fills or drains a whole pool, from the top down to the hose end. It needs [#](2E5AAC)[rotation](entry://create_basics/rotation)[#]() to lower.
